title: BlackboardResolution
description: Immutable snapshot of a Blackboard taken at phase quiescence. Instantiated TWICE per Run by the engine: once as `sourceResolution` (snapshot of `SourceBlackboard` at Source-phase quiescence; read by Target-phase KSs via `controlContext.sourceResolution()` returning a `BlackboardResolutionView`) and once as `targetResolution` (snapshot of `TargetBlackboard` at Target-phase quiescence; consumed by the Pipeline and persisted for audit). Both instances follow the same schema; the `blackboard` discriminator names which Blackboard was snapshotted. Persisted in `BundleStore` as a versioned artefact for replay (I-12).

resolutionId.description: Engine-set unique id for this resolution artefact.

runId.description: Run id this BlackboardResolution was produced by.

blackboard.description: Discriminator: which Blackboard instance was snapshotted. `SourceBlackboard` for `sourceResolution`; `TargetBlackboard` for `targetResolution`.

resolvedAt.description: Wall-clock time of the snapshot (set when the corresponding Controller declared quiescence).

sourcePackUris.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URIs of the Sourcing Packs whose KSs and panels participated in the Run (echoed on both resolutions for self-describing replay).

panels.description: Snapshot of the snapshotted Blackboard's panels. One entry per panel. The `slots` map carries the resolved values per identity AND the full underlying Contribution log (so a downstream consumer may call either `resolved(panel, key)` or `contributionsOf(panel, key)` against the BlackboardResolutionView, mirroring the live Blackboard accessors).

description.description: Optional free-form description echoed from the Panel record.
